idea.title: ToolForge — Generate MCP tools from OpenAPI specs automatically

plan.tagline: Turn any OpenAPI spec into ready-to-use MCP tools in seconds
plan.problem: Indie devs waste hours manually converting OpenAPI specs into MCP tools—tedious, error-prone, and blocks automation projects
plan.solution: Parse OpenAPI specs, auto-generate Python MCP tool files with proper typing, CLI flags, and error handling—just run and use instantly
plan.target_market: Solo Python devs and indie hackers building automation tools for APIs without backend teams
mvp_features: Generate typed MCP tool files with docstrings
Hardcoded demo mode with GitHub API mock

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for tool storage + CLI add/list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: report generation of generated tools + basic error alerts

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: --demo mode with hardcoded GitHub API mock + help text + edge cases

plan.demo_script: Run `openapi2mcp --demo` to see 3 pre-generated MCP tools from GitHub API spec—no internet needed. Lists tools, shows sample usage, and validates output structure
